claims.quote: We previously developed a gene-trap Scn2a (Scn2a gt/gt ) mouse model with a global NaV1.2 reduction in the widely used C57BL/6N (B6) strain.

claims.object_text: broad downregulation of voltage-gated potassium channel (KV) genes, including KV1.1
claims.quote: RNA sequencing revealed significant alterations in gene expression in the Scn2a gt/gt mice, in particular a broad downregulation of voltage-gated potassium channel (KV) genes, including KV1.1.

claims.object_text: reduction of KV1.1 expression in human cerebral organoids with SCN2A deficiency
claims.quote: The reduction of KV1.1 expression was further validated in human cerebral organoids with SCN2A deficiency,
delivery of exogenous human KV1.1 expression via adeno-associated virus (AAV) in D2J Scn2a gt/gt mice substantially reduced absence seizures.
